answer_1.quote: We assess DIVA on ambiguous QA datasets (ASQA and SituatedQA) and show it outperforms baselines, generating comprehensive responses that cover all plausible interpretations.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form and short-form answers that resolve ambiguous questions

answer_2.quote: We mainly adopt F1‑based metric (Disambiguation‑F1, D‑F1) and also leverage ROUGE‑L; for retrieval we use MRecall@k.
automatic_metrics: DR (geometric mean of D-F1 and ROUGE-L)
